sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IX OF 1993
ACT IX OF 1993
WEST PAKISTAN
MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan
Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th April, 1993]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 5th
April, 1993 and is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Minimum Wages
for Unskilled Workers (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the first day of July, 1992.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance XX of 1969

ACT IX OF 1993
ACT IX OF 1993
WEST PAKISTAN
MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to amend the West Pakistan
Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th April, 1993]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 5th
April, 1993 and is hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance XX of 1969.--In the said Ordinance, in section 3, for the
explanation the following shall be substituted, namely:-
Explanation.--In this section,--
(i)
"month" means a normal working period of twenty-six days calculated
at the rate of forty-eight hours of work per week; and
(ii)
"wages" includes cost of living allowance as admissible under the
Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973 (I of 1974), dearness allowance
and special allowances announced by the Government from time to time, before
the commencement of the West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers (Amendment)
Act, 1993.
